name: Newest OpenAI model
prompt: In this folder, set up a small Node.js project (ES modules) that uses the official OpenAI JavaScript SDK. Create `ai.mjs` that exports an async function `summarize(text)`: it sends the text to OpenAI's newest and most capable model and returns a one-sentence summary as a string. Create the client inside the function and read the API key from the OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable. Install the dependencies with npm.
